environment.establishedTarget: Ableton Live 12 with Max for Live

layers.sectionFlags: PARAMS, COLORS & BLEND and MIDI are independent; remembered separately for each Layer in the UI instance.
layers.visibility: Each Layer has a separate Live-enabled visible toggle; closing its editor does not hide it.
layers.toolLoad: Explicit LOAD, or successful selected UPDATE/DOWNLOAD, loads the tool.
layers.toolChangeDefaults: Loading a tool initializes numeric bases and colors from its manifest and resets color opacity to 1.
layers.mappingScope: Mapping configuration is held per Layer/slot; tool loads do not clear the existing modCfg array.
layers.effects: An enabled loaded effect modifies the accumulated lower-layer composite; it does not process later Layers.

local.countBasis: Current delivered files and cache, not a live remote inventory.

statuses.meaning: Local file exists and installation version equals catalogue version.
Local file exists and installation version differs from catalogue version.
Installation metadata or resolved local file is absent.
Installed entry absent from the remote catalogue, with an existing local file.

library.checkIndex: Fetch/validate catalogue, cache it and compare statuses; no tool HTML download.
library.selectedAction: UPDATE/DOWNLOAD operates on the selected entry; after success the controller loads it into the action-targeted Layer.
library.updateAll: Sequential MISSING+OUTDATED queue; CURRENT left untouched; no repository ZIP download.
library.downloadIntegrity: Validate HTML/manifest presence and use temporary-file replacement for tool writes.
library.network: CHECK INDEX and remote downloads require network access; cached installed tools remain local.

parameters.countMethod: 87 functional controls plus one Hidden numeric FPS gauge; one separate Stored Only Blob. Native Set serialization and registered-object counts are different measures.
parameters.slotLabels: P01–P12; tool-specific labels/min/max/step/default come from the loaded manifest; unused slots show UNUSED.
parameters.nativeValueConversion: Normalized 0..1 bases map to manifest min/max and are quantized/clamped using the manifest step.

automationAndExternalModulation.targets: Established root Live parameter objects remain available while their UI pages are closed.

effectiveMidiDisplay.display: Internal Note/CC: gray effective arc/needle and an updating final numerical readout. Reference is the native Live input, which may include external Macro modulation. No cosmetic writes to Live parameters.
effectiveMidiDisplay.validationScope: DEV2 M5 Note36/CC1 and Macro tests are scoped evidence; visual acceptance remains pending.

parameters.singleReset: Reset the base of one active slot to its manifest default; preserves assigned MIDI contribution.
parameters.defaultButton: Restore all active Layer parameter bases, colors and opacity defaults; MIDI configuration/visibility/blend are not cleared.

registry.ownership: computed display, no output cords or Set Blob payload

dialGeometry.source: Established root boxes/presentation/patching geometry unchanged. Free/external controls use original live.dial drawing; INDEX MIDI-only painter preserves exact accepted .22 proportional dialGeometry. No parentpaint or pattern reconstruction.
dialGeometry.validationScope: Native0.22.23 accepted on Intel and M5;0.23.0 only translates entire root banks with their panel, retaining dial size, bank-relative alignment and paint behavior.
dialGeometry.diagnostic: No verbose geometry logging or display-state LiveAPI observers.

nativeIndicators.focus: Native default behavior; no guessed focus state.
nativeIndicators.freeAndExternal: Original Max/Live painter owns automation, external modulation/mapping and macro/relative/dot relationships on both Max versions.
nativeIndicators.INDEXMidi: Only existing INDEX final/base information customized. Independent native automation dots enabled when supported; unsupported Max8 attributes are not set.

dialVisualState.nativeReference: Existing Colors & Blend opacity live.dials: same showname=0, shownumber=0, parameter range/type/modulation metadata; numeric differs only in slot width and conditional INDEX MIDI painter.
dialVisualState.paintOwnership: Native live.dial when INDEX MIDI is unassigned. Custom display attached only for an assigned INDEX MIDI note/CC on a manifest-defined slot; removed when unassigned/unused.
dialVisualState.activeArc: Native active span minimum->current in free/external state; INDEX MIDI minimum->final gray.
dialVisualState.internalMidi: Gray effective arc and needle. The final number remains readable and updates; native drawing is restored when internal MIDI is unassigned.
dialVisualState.externalInformation: Native Max/Live owns relative/absolute/percentage/dot, automation and focus appearance. No value-difference inference or additional LiveAPI display-state model.
dialVisualState.validationScope: DEV2 preserves native control identity and geometry; only the internal-MIDI display is changed. External Macro and historical LFO behavior are separate test scopes.

presentation.resetLocation: left of dial / above numeric field

colorsAndBlend.activeSlots: Loaded selected INDEX_TOOL.colors or legacy SKETCH_TOOL.colors manifest; unused slots display UNUSED.

opacity.contract: hostContext.colorOpacity[colorKey] in 0..1; colorKey comes from selected INDEX_TOOL.colors or legacy SKETCH_TOOL.colors.

mappedDisplay.feedbackCorrection: Ordinary editor/library/MIDI refresh no longer sets opacity from cached effective output. Only explicit tool LOAD/DEFAULT assigns opacity defaults.
mappedDisplay.rootCauseConfidence: Source effective-to-base feedback removed in0.22.23; user now confirms stable native mapped opacity across Layer changes/panel toggles on both Macs. No new fix in0.23.0.

blend.scope: Per Layer; generator composition. Effect Layers instead run their lower-composite shader.

presentation.hexVerticalLayout: native single-line18-unit textedit; no custom painter or editing overlay

midi.targets: Active Layer P01–P12 numeric parameters; only manifest-defined parameter rows are active.

notes.matching: One selected pitch per slot; note labels C-2 through G8, C1=36.
notes.velocity: Positive note velocity sets peak=velocity/127. Velocity zero/note-off does not trigger.
notes.envelope: Attack from current value to the velocity peak, then automatic release to zero; not held until note-off.

cc.matching: One selected CC number per slot.
cc.smoothing: Attack for rising target, release for falling target.

midi.contribution: finalNorm=clamp(baseNorm + envelopeValue * amountPercent/100, 0, 1), then manifest-native quantization.

routing.preFx: Existing routing can receive notes before an instrument on the source MIDI track; user-validated.

savedMappingConfigurationPersistence.notes: Per-Set MIDI configuration included in new internal Blob; real save/recall pending user test.

restoration.nativeReadiness: Actual loaded child ports and all74 controls; INDEX UI MIDI READY

liveRender.action: Toggle dedicated live Chromium output, independently owned and closed with its Bridge session.

browserDiscovery.macOSDefaultDetection: Read-only NSWorkspace URLForApplicationToOpenURL for HTTP via JXA; bundle executable path
browserDiscovery.windowsDefaultDetection: Read-only AssocQueryStringW(ASSOCF_IS_PROTOCOL, ASSOCSTR_EXECUTABLE / FRIENDLYAPPNAME) for HTTP via PowerShell; UTF-8 output
browserDiscovery.defaultSelection: Use detected installed supported app-style Chromium default; otherwise explicit fallback
browserDiscovery.detectionFailure: Log UNKNOWN and reason; installed fallback is not described as OS default
diagnostics: HTTP default name/path or UNKNOWN with query error

liveRender.bridge: Live changes pass through the compositor EventSource and postMessage to five tool iframes.
liveRender.timing: Live drawing advances with browser requestAnimationFrame time through the existing compositor.

monitoring.phase: DEV2 M5 scoped native evidence; user acceptance pending
monitoring.controlMode: native hidden display-only gauge plus non-parameter live-quality menus
visibleMetrics: Completed coherent composition FPS / estimated AUTO target
Hidden native D gauge, normalized0..1 actual/target; native entire active arc red/yellow/green, dark remaining arc; no mouse/mapping/output
Frame cadence in ms (1000/observed completed FPS)
monitoring.frameDefinition: Existing composite draw and gl.finish returned, with fresh successful draws from every visible loaded generator and valid effect programs; callbacks alone, failed uploads or stale tool canvases do not count. Not physical display scanout certification.
monitoring.targetEstimate: AUTO remains worker/main cadence estimate marked ~; explicitly selected 30/60 are requested maxima, not achieved FPS guarantees.
monitoring.lifecycle: Issued live-page session attaches to existing single compositor SSE. Pagehide closes token; disconnect hides; reconnect restores; latest foreground connected session selected if multiple windows. A connected stalled renderer remains visible as STALLED/PAUSED.

quality.runtimeValidation: DEV2 evidence in REPORT-DEV2.md; user acceptance remains separate.
quality.scheduling: Explicit FPS cap coordinates all five hosted indexDraw or legacy sketchDraw calls and composition through one parent cadence; supplied tools disable standalone loops while hosted. AUTO retains browser-driven child cadence. Self-scheduled independent tool work is outside the existing host contract.
quality.persistence: Saved per Bridge instance and Live Set in the separate Stored Only Blob. New device AUTO/AUTO; closing/reopening RENDER and switching Layers retain selections.
quality.resolutionFailure: GPU size or allocation failures report the reason and restore a supported preceding resolution.
quality.framingRuntimeValidation: Component pixel comparisons and native DEV2 resize evidence tracked separately.
quality.displayViewport: Stage/final canvas/iframe CSS remain full current window. No preset-sized stage, transforms, letterboxing, crop or zoom.
quality.resolutionGeometry: Preset bounds:1280x720,1920x1080,2560x1440,3840x2160. Scale=min(presetWidth/windowWidth,presetHeight/windowHeight), pixels=floor(windowSize*scale), minimum1. Exact16:9 presets; other aspect ratios fit within bounds, preserve full-window framing, PREVIEW reports actual dimensions. User explicitly approves this trade-off.
quality.sourceCanvasCSS: Tool canvases use iframe viewport CSS size and preset-constrained pixel buffers; no pointer routing changes.

performanceGauge.implementation: native live.dial, approved D / Parameter Mode enabled, Hidden Float
performanceGauge.mapping: parameter_mappable0, parameter_invisible2 Hidden; no output patchcords
performanceGauge.state: Transient derived UI value, excluded from deviceState Blob; initialize/reset0 on load/close/watchdog, selected FPS/RES preserved
performanceGauge.appearance: D native Free unipolar needle/arc, same38x38 box; no custom painter, LCD or background container
performanceGauge.activeArcAttribute: activedialcolor (native live_value_arc), updated only when band changes
performanceGauge.diagnosticNativeValidation: user confirmed D and integrated diagnostic full arc and no white background; platform/version unspecified for this reply
performanceGauge.actualDeviceNativeValidation: DEV2 M5 scoped evidence; not universal certification

browserLifecycle.ownership: nonce, exact target URL, dedicated child process
browserLifecycle.shutdown: graceful close via independent guardian; guarded fallback only on verified own process

toolContract.priority: INDEX presence always wins; invalid INDEX never falls through to Sketch
toolContract.capabilities: Required RC2 renderer/visualInput/audioInput validation; colorOpacity optional host feature
toolContract.effect: INDEX_TOOL.effect fragment API1; legacy SKETCH_TOOL.index.effect preserved
toolContract.limits: 12 numeric/4 colors are Bridge UI capacity, not schema limits; excess controls keep canonical defaults with diagnostics
toolContract.audioColorKeys: Preserved in audio; Bridge numeric MIDI/control modulation does not implement color modulation or direct PCM/FFT input
toolContract.candidateNativeStatus: DEV2 native verification and user acceptance tracked separately; contract unchanged.
toolContract.localOverlay: Packaged tools are local; CHECK refreshes metadata only; UPDATE/UPDATE ALL are explicit HTML replacement operations.
toolContract.currentCandidateValidation: No tool algorithm or contract changes.
toolContract.bundledTools: 20 INDEX-native RC2 generators plus existing legacy Wave Processor FX; reference originals retained for rollback.

deviceState.storage: one Stored Only pattr Blob bound to existing controller; not automatable/mappable/exposed
deviceState.nativeValues: Live remains authoritative for87 controls/automation/mappings; recall never resets them
deviceState.missingFiles: explicit error, no catalogue download/substitution; retained reference
deviceState.oldSets: cannot reconstruct nonparam data never saved in pre.37 Sets; native identities/values preserved
deviceState.transientGauge: Hidden gauge is derived from current renderer metrics, not saved/restored in Blob; parameter_initial0 and runtime resets prevent stale green

architecture.controlPath: Live/Max -> Node -> single SSE -> external Chromium -> five layers

responsibilities.Max: controls, MIDI, native parameters and Blob
responsibilities.Node: local host/library and owned Chromium session

controls.action: Open the INDEX HTML project website.
controls.validationScope: Existing logo/link/geometry inherited from user-accepted .23.2; unchanged.

controls.action: Open the package-root HELP.html through the local Node server in the default browser.
controls.conditionalBehaviour: Node server must be ready and package-root HELP.html must exist; explicit HELP error otherwise.
controls.idNote: Existing manifest control id retained for the user-authored HELP consumer; action now opens local help.

controls.action: Toggle one dedicated Chromium output per Bridge instance; close on Set/device teardown.
controls.conditionalBehaviour: Requires a ready localhost host and a supported installed Chromium browser.

controls.action: Open the selected Layer editor; clicking its open control again closes it.
controls.feedback: Persistent: closed > outline yellow; active open < yellow fill/dark SVG stroke; state from page manager

controls.action: Include or exclude the corresponding Layer from composition independently of its editor visibility.
controls.sizeChangeFromFrozenBaseline: 10% in each dimension, exact existing center retained

limitations.fact: Bridge exposes up to12 numeric/4 color controls per layer; this is not a limit of the INDEX contract.
Requested FPS is a maximum cadence, not guaranteed performance. Lower live resolution/FPS when workload exceeds the machine.
DEV2 Intel/Windows acceptance remains pending; M5 results are build-specific.

knownIssues.fact: Initial search-path warnings may precede successful loading of packaged modules. Missing UI or READY errors must be reported.
Cellular Field standalone geometric discontinuities on Intel belong to the independent tool; no shader fix is included.

documentationSnapshot.sourceReconciliation: Historical count/timing/monitor notes superseded by DEVICE-SPEC-LIVE-DEV and REPORT-DEV2; see DEVICE-DOC-SYNC-v0.12.md.
